description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the DateUtils class, specifically testing week number calculations and date comparisons.

classes.name: DateUtilsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various date-related utility functions in DateUtils.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup before all tests, mocking static methods in DateUtils.TimeUtils.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleanup after all tests, closing the mocked static.

methods.name: mockFirstWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to a date in the first week of the year and tests week number retrieval.

methods.name: mockFortiethWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to a date in the 40th week of the year and tests week number retrieval.

methods.name: mockLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Mocks currentDateTime to a date in the last week of the year and tests week number retrieval.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeekNumberOfYear
methods.description: Tests that week number calculation matches expected values for given dates.

methods.name: correctlyGetWeeksLeftInYearFromCurrentWeek
methods.description: Tests calculation of remaining weeks in the year from current week numbers.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInCurrentYear
methods.description: Tests whether dates are correctly identified as being in the current year.

methods.name: correctlyCheckIfDateIsInFuture
methods.description: Tests whether dates are correctly identified as being in the future.

methods.name: calculateWeeksLeftInYear
methods.description: Helper method to calculate remaining weeks given the current week number.
